query:
INSERT INTO project_members (projectId, userId, role, invitedAt)
SELECT p.id, p.ownerId, 'owner', NOW()
FROM projects p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm 
  WHERE pm.projectId = p.id AND pm.userId = p.ownerId
);
